changes:
Aurora's Mesa (aurora-silicon/mesa 9a21c0c6220, 26.3.0-devel) with Debian's mesa 26.1.6-1 packaging and binary package names.
alarm-aurora's driver selection: Asahi Gallium, Zink and softpipe, the Borealis Vulkan driver, lavapipe and Rusticl; the native GL and Vulkan drivers link neither LLVM nor SPIRV-Tools.
Drop the drivers Apple Silicon cannot use, Teflon, drm-shim and the Gallium VA-API front end.
Revision 2 moves with mesa-aurora-fex-guest and aurora-flatpak-gl, which depend on libgl1-mesa-dri and mesa-vulkan-drivers at exactly their own version.
notes: Starts from Debian testing's mesa 26.1.6-1 debian/ directory. Cross builds run the host LLVM, bindgen and the CL compilers through binfmt_misc (qemu-user); see docs/parity/graphics.md.
